mechanism: Mechanical interaction between screw and implant
causal_chain: Increased screw diameter reduces cyclic loading stress
Reduced cyclic loading stress decreases risk of screw deformation

predictions.conditions: Implant-abutment screw diameter increased by 0.5mm, cyclic loading frequency of 100Hz, and 1000 loading cycles

experiment_plan.objective: To investigate the effect of increasing the diameter of the implant-abutment screw on cyclic loading stress.
dependent_variables: Cyclic loading stress on implant-abutment screw
procedure: Prepare 10 identical implants with standard diameter implant-abutment screws.
Prepare 10 identical implants with increased diameter implant-abutment screws (0.5mm larger).
Apply cyclic loading to each implant at a frequency of 100Hz for 1000 loading cycles.
Measure the cyclic loading stress on each implant-abutment screw using a load cell.
Repeat steps 3-4 for the implants with increased diameter implant-abutment screws at a cyclic loading frequency of 200Hz.
experiment_plan.expected_result: A 30% decrease in cyclic loading stress on implant-abutment screw with increased diameter.
experiment_plan.falsification_condition: No significant decrease in cyclic loading stress observed when implant-abutment screw diameter is increased by 0.5mm, and cyclic loading frequency is increased to 200Hz.
experiment_plan.sample_requirements: 10 identical implants for each condition (standard diameter and increased diameter implant-abutment screws).
experiment_plan.safety_constraints: Ensure that the cyclic loading frequency and amplitude do not cause damage to the implants or surrounding tissue.
experiment_plan.information_gain: Understanding the effect of implant-abutment screw diameter on cyclic loading stress, which can inform the design of more durable dental implants.
